verdict.rationale: NVIDIA documents a programmatic interface (CUDA Toolkit, CUDA Tile C++/cuTile Python) for driving GPU compute, which is the closest analog to a 'public API' for a hardware product, but there is no REST/OpenAPI-style public API for agentic/AI-native automation — probes for openapi/swagger endpoints and markdown docs all 404. Missing for 10: a discoverable REST/OpenAPI spec or agent-friendly API surface, and independent confirmation that AI agents can programmatically drive the product beyond writing CUDA kernels.
